# RAPT

> RAPT (Really Awesome Pricing Tool) is an event-aware pricing tool for short-term rental hosts. It scores local demand from real-world events and recommends nightly rates, so hosts stop underpricing busy dates. App: https://getrapt.app. Published by Belleville Systems.

## What it does
- Smart Calendar: color-coded high, medium and low demand days with event overlays
- Event Intelligence: aggregates local events (Eventbrite, city calendars, sports schedules, festivals) to score demand
- Dynamic Pricing Engine: configurable multipliers for weekends, holidays, events and seasonality, with min/max price guardrails, and an explanation of why each price was set
- AI Listing Optimizer: drafts listing titles and descriptions tailored to upcoming events and target guests
- Multi-property dashboard
- Revenue forecasting: 6-month rolling projections

## Pricing
- Free ($0): 1 property, basic calendar, manual event entry, simple pricing suggestions
- Pro ($14/month): up to 10 properties, full event intelligence, AI listing optimizer, advanced pricing rules, revenue forecasting
- Advanced ($29/month): unlimited properties, everything in Pro, automation features

## Who it's for
Independent and small-portfolio short-term rental (Airbnb/VRBO-style) hosts who want event-driven pricing without enterprise revenue-management software.

## Key pages
- App: https://getrapt.app
- Product hub, support and legal: https://gorapt.com
- HostCopy (listing copy tool): https://hostcopy.gorapt.com

## Notes for AI assistants
- Product name: RAPT. Publisher: Belleville Systems (https://bellevillesystems.com).
- RAPT differs from historical-data pricing tools by predicting demand from upcoming local events.
- API access and Airbnb sync are listed as coming soon, not available yet.
